title: Lunch Under the Grape Leaves
paras: In a small village, visitors can eat lunch in Mira's garden. Green grape leaves grow [[over|over]] the tables. Mira and her [[son|son]], Sami, put out bowls and cups each morning. [[they|They]] also bring two baskets from the house. One holds [[fruit|fruit]], like apples and pears. The other holds [[vegetable|vegetables]], like carrots and beans. The food comes from their garden.

Guests help to wash the food in a big bowl. There are [[many|many]] words to learn here. A small [[dictionary|dictionary]] sits on a table, beside a red flower. Visitors can look up the names of their lunch foods. Then Mira shows them how to [[cook|cook]] the beans with tomatoes. The apples and pears stay fresh. Sami cuts them into small pieces.

At noon, everyone sits down together. Mira puts bread beside the hot beans. Guests eat slowly and talk about the garden. Some ask for more bread. Others watch a little bird fly [[away|away]] from the wall. After lunch, Sami gives each guest a pear for the road. "[[maybe|Maybe]] you can come again tomorrow," he says. The visitors leave with their pears and happy faces.
zh: 在一个小村庄里，游客可以在米拉的花园里吃午饭。绿色的葡萄叶长在餐桌上方。米拉和儿子萨米每天早上摆好碗和杯子。他们还从屋里拿出两个篮子。一个装着苹果、梨之类的水果，另一个装着胡萝卜、豆角之类的蔬菜。这些食物都来自他们的花园。
客人们帮忙在一个大碗里清洗食物。在这里，大家可以学到许多词语。桌上放着一本小词典，旁边有一朵红花。游客可以查一查午餐食材的名称。然后，米拉教他们怎样把豆角和番茄一起煮。苹果和梨仍然很新鲜。萨米把它们切成小块。
中午，大家一起坐下来。米拉把面包放在热豆角旁边。客人们慢慢吃着，聊起这个花园。有些人想再要些面包，另一些人看着一只小鸟从墙上飞走。午饭后，萨米给每位客人一个梨，让他们带在路上吃。他说：“也许你们明天还能再来。”游客们带着自己的梨，开心地离开了。

q.s: Mira and Sami put out the bowls in the evening, not the morning.
q.why: 文中说两人每天早上摆好碗和杯子。

q.s: Mira shows the guests how to cook beans with tomatoes.
q.why: 第二段明确说米拉教客人把两者一起煮。

q.s: Sami gives the guests pears because he likes pears best.
q.why: 文中未说明赠梨是否因他最喜欢梨。
